name: TTL Heartbeats, Leases, and Pub/Sub Discipline
description: Implement agent heartbeats (TTL 30s with auto-expiry detection). Implement work leases (SET NX with TTL, EXPIRE renewal, stale lease recovery). Enforce pub/sub discipline: only volatile UI signals use pub/sub; durable events go through PGlite + Streams. This lane is blocked from claiming kernel completion until durable ACK binding proves that every lease-acquired and lease-expired transition is observable in PGlite.
